# Personal notes {.unnumbered}

This chapter only exists in the **local** build of the book (rendered with
`QUARTO_PROFILE=local`). It is not published to the course website.

## Personal slides

- [Estimating and specifying time-varying beta](time-varying-beta.html) —
  least-squares fitting of a constant beta, a regime change, seasonal beta,
  covariate rescaling, and free-form trends. Source:
  `personal/time-varying-beta.qmd` in the repo.

To re-render the personal slides after editing:

```sh
cd personal && quarto render time-varying-beta.qmd
```
